MS1.summary: Current public claim boundary: token/cost saving is not ready; true vector-hybrid latency is ready only for a bounded local synthetic probe; retrieval recall is ready only for local smoke source-hit recall.
facts: claim_readiness.token_cost_saving.ready is false because the token-visible paired run has negative saving deltas for T1 and T3.
claim_readiness.true_vector_hybrid_latency.ready is true, but only for the local synthetic true-hybrid probe with no fallback.
claim_readiness.retrieval_recall.ready is true, but only for local smoke source-hit recall across FTS/vector/hybrid.
Source-hit recall is not end-to-end answer correctness, and local synthetic latency is not production latency.

MS2.summary: codedb-mcp is a code-knowledge compiler reference; evo is an orchestration runtime reference. Neither should be treated as a harness-mem memory runtime competitor.
facts: Borrow codedb-mcp's project-local generated layer, setup/use separation, intermediate structure before prose, and tool-cost observer ideas.
Do not promote codedb-mcp generated DeepWiki prose into confirmed truth or borrow its code-intel benchmark results as harness-mem savings.
Borrow evo's explicit runtime ledger, host adapter matrix, version lockstep, directive/ack protocol, and prioritization registry ideas.
Do not turn harness-mem into a default autonomous experiment runtime or benchmark optimizer.

MS3.summary: Controlled automation exists, but ordinary coding tasks still do not use installed-by-default always-on memory learning or silent truth mutation.
facts: Conversation-level autopilot, opt-in host hook / scheduler trigger, and default-off Auto Dream are controlled automation paths.
No installed-by-default always-on daemon or unconditional turn-end self-check is the current ordinary coding path.
suggest_rule and suggest_memory_entry are candidate-write interfaces, not silent truth mutation.
Confirmed truth changes must preserve candidate, review, supersede, and ledger boundaries.

MS4.summary: Generated compact/wiki artifacts are derived cache. They may summarize and navigate evidence, but they are not authority and cannot replace source truth.
facts: Generated knowledge requires source-map and freshness metadata for publishable claims.
Generated prose cannot launder citations or contaminate confirmed truth.
Freshness and invalidation state must be visible.
Generated cache remains separate from source/truth stores.

MS5.summary: Temporal truth separates current and historical reads, valid time and recorded time, and supersede explanation without deleting history.
facts: valid_from, valid_to, and recorded_at are separate temporal dimensions.
Supersede explains replacement and keeps historical truth available.
Current/history/as_of behavior must not be collapsed.
Ambiguous temporal scope should be surfaced instead of guessed.

MS6.summary: Cost/token public claims are gated separately from observability, and diagnostic benchmark artifacts are excluded from release snapshots unless explicitly promoted.
facts: Cost discipline is a separate benchmark class.
False-success accounting, budget overrun evidence, and truncation evidence are tracked before public claims.
Diagnostic, partial, quarantined, or release_snapshot=false artifacts are excluded from release snapshots.
Cloud telemetry and real billing remain out of scope unless a separate benchmark is added.

MS7.summary: Daily workflow goes through Slash, MCP, and Skills. CLI remains local operations and troubleshooting.
facts: wake/search/timeline/candidate review are agent/MCP or Slash workflows.
session distill uses MCP prepare_session_distill plus the session-distill skill or agent candidate writes.
CLI is for install, doctor, purge, maintenance, API server, and file import operations.
Users should not be routed to hand-run daily wake/search/timeline CLI commands.

MS8.summary: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 remains the default embedding baseline. bge-small-en-v1.5 and nomic-embed-text-v1.5 are configurable shootout candidates.
facts: Changing the default requires recall, latency, cache/disk, and install-friction evidence.
A local smoke source-hit recall run is not enough to change the default.
The retrieval shootout preserves embedding candidate governance without silently changing the default.
